newsitem.title: NETHERLANDS: Fugro sees higher results in H1.
newsitem.headline: Fugro sees higher results in H1.

text.p: Dutch engineering consultancy Fugro said on Monday it expected higher turnover and profits in the first half of 1997 compared to the same period in 1996.
Fugro said the negative influence of the winter period on the groups' turnover was smaller than usual and for this reason capacity utilisation had been higher.
Fugro also said it had realised a gain of some 8 million guilders on the sell-off of its American and English environmental division.
Fugro said it would publish its first half results on August 21, before the bourse opens.
First half 1996 profit was 9.6 million guilders and turnover was 368.9 million guilders during the first six months last year. -- Amsterdam newsroom +31 20 504 5000
